sources.title: Multilingual Text Detoxification — My sample book
sources.snippet: Multilingual Text Detoxification # This project addresses the challenge of online toxicity by transforming toxic comments into non-toxic ones while maintaining the original meaning, fluency, and grammatical correctness. It was developed as part of the TextDetox 2024 challenge. The system supports multilingual detoxification, focusing on English and Russian.
